excerpt.zh: 一个摇摆不定的信号萦绕在[Root.GetName]，而且并不来自星球表面。
excerpt.en: A wavering signal haunts [Root.GetName], though it does not seem to originate from the planet's surface.

sections.zh: 一个摇摆不定的信号萦绕在[Root.GetName]，而且并不来自星球表面。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国名称。

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]和缓的运行轨道上竟漂浮着一枚紧急信标。其外壳已被严重损坏，似乎是被武器火力击中或是被大爆炸波及。

这似乎是来自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的民用飞船专属型号——用于在通讯系统故障时作为紧急措施进行发射——但其受损的严重程度使具体情况都不得而知了。

它一直在重复一个微弱而失真的信号。
texts.en:
An emergency transmission buoy floats in gentle orbit around [From.GetName]. Its outer casing is heavily damaged, seemingly by glancing weapons fire or a powerful explosion.

It might be a [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] model for civilian ships - designed to be ejected as an emergency measure should the comms systems fail - but the extent of the damage makes it impossible to know for certain.

It is repeating a weak, distorted signal.

label.zh: 也许是陷阱——最好不要以身犯险。
label.en: It could be a trap - best leave it be.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的物种的形容词。
note.en: In the game, your species' adjective appears here.

texts.zh: 我们发现了一个严重受损的物体，这似乎是一个通讯信标。
texts.en: A heavily-damaged object seems to act as a repeater for a comms signal.

texts.zh: 信标已确定来自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]，其发射的信号已趋于稳定。
texts.en: The buoy has been verified as one of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] make, and the signal it's relaying has been stabilized.

label.zh: 这里是[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国。请亮明身份。
彻底关掉。这件事到此为止。
label.en: Shut it down. No one is to speak of this.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的物种的形容词。
note.en: In the game, your species' adjective appears here.

texts.zh:
有、有人吗？这里是[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]民用运输船“卢克西昂号”的舰长。

啊，应该说是前舰长。卢克西昂已经不复存在了。我们被海盗登船，我们在飞船爆炸前就被掳走成了人质。
texts.en:
He- hello? This is the captain of the Luxion, a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] civilian transport.

Uh, former captain. The Luxion is gone. We were boarded by pirates and taken captive before they blew up the ship.

responses.zh:
他们……我、我听他们好像自称星际什么来着？星际绑架者是吧？

他们可不是善茬。如果他们认为不能从[Root.GetName]手中得到些什么来换取我们的性命就会干掉我们。我偷听到他们已经在讨论要开什么条件了……
responses.en:
They, I- I think they call themselves the ransomers? The Ransomeers?

At any rate they're a vile bunch, we'd all be dead already if they didn't think they could get something for us from the [Root.GetName]. I've overhead them discussing their demands...

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的物种的形容词。
note.en: In the game, your species' adjective appears here.

texts.zh:
什么？什么？！你们不能见死不救！

要是他们认为不能用我们向[Root.GetName]索取赎金的话，绝对会连眼都不眨就宰了我们的！就连真的付了赎金的话我们的性命也没有保障啊！你们不能——
texts.en:
What? What? You can't. You can't not save us!

If they get it into their heads that they won't be able to ransom us back to the [Root.GetName] they won't hesitate to kill us. They'll probably kill us even if the ransom is paid! You can't--

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的物种的形容词。
note.en: In the game, your species' adjective appears here.

texts.zh:
哦，真是太感谢了，太感谢了啊！[Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们似乎被关在某个空间站，但具体位置我也不知道。

我这就加强传输频率，你们应该可以通过紧急信标进行三角测量，确认我们被绑架的位置……
texts.en:
Oh thank you! Thank you, [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We're being held in some space station, but I have no idea where we are beyond that.

I will increase the transmission burst now, it should let you triangulate the location of this prison from the emergency buoy...

label.zh: 位置已记录于情报日志。
label.en: Position recorded in the Situation Log.

# 多普勒效应 / Doppler Effect

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/anomalies/01_anomaly_categories.txt:1070-1096` · `events/anomaly_events_2.txt` · `common/event_chains/`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 3级异常，权重3；仅在有毒/寒冷贫瘠/贫瘠/冰冻/核毁行星上，且所有者拥有旗标birth_of_piracy、不是群体意识时生成。  
  Level-3 anomaly, weight 3; only on toxic/cold barren/barren/frozen/nuked planets whose owner has the birth_of_piracy flag and is not gestalt consciousness.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 单一结局3090“赎金客：紧急浮标”（研究）→EMERGENCY_BUOY_PROJECT→3091：a联络→3092，b关闭。  
  Single outcome 3090 (research) → EMERGENCY_BUOY_PROJECT → 3091: a contacts the captives → 3092, b shuts it down.
- 3092：b拒绝救援→3093结束；c救援→3094→赎金客事件链（ransomeer_chain）。  
  3092: b refuses → 3093 (end); c agrees → 3094 → the Ransomeers event chain (ransomeer_chain).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 结局：3093拒绝救援，或进入赎金客事件链。  
  Endings: 3093 (abandoned) or the Ransomeers chain.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 必须已触发“海盗诞生”旗标。  
  Requires the birth_of_piracy flag.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已对照类别脚本与树；赎金客事件链本身不属于本故事。  
  Compared category script and tree; the Ransomeers chain itself is outside this story.
- 覆盖 Coverage：全部8个文档。 / All 8 docs.
